hardware.gpu_hour_definition: one allocated GPU for one hour; one fully occupied four-GPU node hour consumes four GPU-hours
hardware.throughput_authority: measured end-to-end fixed-shape GH200 tokens per second, not peak hardware FLOPs

included: dense architecture decisions C0 D2 D3 D4 D6 D7 D8
integrated data-architecture and assembled-recipe validation I1-I3
dense scale ladder and mature-token-horizon reversal sentinel
quality long-context systems and serving evaluation
excluded: FP4 cache qualification as a launch gate

phases.name: pregrant readiness
work: storage and data-volume readiness
flagship corpora and neutral held-out set
2B production-data calibration plus explicit 20B and 150B/500B scale decision
4xGH200 environment and resume qualification
source-balanced tokenizer sample custom candidates matched LM pilot and D5 decision
selectable backward-compatible KDA output gate
comparator baseline table
scale geometries plus data architecture integration and paper analysis contracts
phases.exit_gate: every item in PREGRANT.md is complete or has an explicit owner and non-GPU fallback

phases.name: calibration and high-leverage screens
work: E1W web source-filter screen and confirmations: 133 GPU-hours
E1S code math and synthetic source screens: 27 GPU-hours
E3 epoch and repetition policy: 32 GPU-hours
D4 LR and global-batch sweep: 33 GPU-hours
D6 LR-width transfer anchors: 5 GPU-hours
phases.exit_gate: source treatments repetition policy and transferable LR region are frozen

phases.name: stable mixture and dense architecture decisions
work: E2 tiered stable-mixture search narrowing and confirmation: 251 GPU-hours
after E2c freezes stable data, C0 three-seed shared dense control: 63 GPU-hours
D2 NoPE versus partial RoPE: 63 GPU-hours
D3 3:1 versus 5:1 recurrent-global ratio: 63 GPU-hours
D7 KDA versus scalar-decay GDN under sigmoid NoPE: 63 GPU-hours
D8 KDA sigmoid versus SiLU output gate: 63 GPU-hours
phases.exit_gate: stable mixture passes category guardrails and sealed audit; position treatment mixer ratio recurrent operator and output gate are selected by frozen rules

phases.name: decay integrated validation and scale transfer
work: E4 decay-phase mixture: 50 GPU-hours
I1 five-seed crossed data-mixture by architecture transfer: 54 GPU-hours
I2 assembled flagship recipe confirmation: up to 63 GPU-hours
I3 integrated capability systems and mechanism analysis: 5 GPU-hours
60M-750M scale ladder plus the 350M mature-horizon sentinel after I2: 268 GPU-hours
phases.exit_gate: data-architecture transfer is measured over five pairs, the assembled recipe or complete C0 fallback is confirmed, scale and mature-horizon reversal are measured, and the fixed 1.2B launch remains supported or is explicitly narrowed

phases.name: configuration freeze
work: freeze the fixed 1.2B model data tokenizer optimizer schedule precision checkpoints context and evaluation
apply documented defaults to unresolved decisions
reject new experiment axes
phases.exit_gate: one hash-bound launch manifest passes CPU and GH200 preflight

phases.name: flagship pretraining
work: stable phase through approximately 80 percent of the frozen target, or 320B tokens at the 400B target
publish the pre-decay checkpoint
decay phase for approximately 20 percent of tokens
publish the final base checkpoint
phases.exit_gate: complete finite base and pre-decay checkpoints with replayable lineage

phases.name: extension post-training evaluation and release
work: 32K then 128K context extension with 4K regression gates
three annealing branches and weight merge
supervised fine-tuning
short and long-context evaluation
GH200 RTX 3090 and CPU serving profiles
native Transformers and GGUF export qualification
phases.exit_gate: release candidates and every mandatory evaluation artifact are complete

phases.name: protected reserve
release_order: recover invalid or interrupted mandatory work
preserve the flagship token target under measured throughput
continue or repair an existing context-extension stage only under its frozen capability and 4K-retention trigger
continue flagship training only after mandatory artifacts are secure
phases.exit_gate: every reserve use cites a frozen trigger and cannot introduce a new axis

phases.name: paper and public release buffer
work: generate tables and figures from checked results
complete claim license limitation and reproducibility audits
publish checkpoints code model cards and paper
phases.exit_gate: every public number resolves to a checked artifact

binding: fixed 1.2B dense-width flagship with 400B target and 320B throughput fallback
neutral held-out evaluation for data decisions
I1 data-architecture transfer and I2 assembled-recipe confirmation
advisory: ordering of independent jobs inside a phase
which GPU runs each independent arm
cut_order: nonmandatory low scale anchors after preserving the 350M and 750M transfer points
forbidden_cuts: mature-token-horizon reversal sentinel while retaining the corresponding horizon-transfer claim

throughput_response.action: keep the 400B target only when measured end-to-end throughput projects inside 2,425 GPU-hours; protect reserve until the pre-decay checkpoint
use reserve only to preserve mandatory work and the flagship token target
apply the cut order before reducing mandatory evaluation

throughput_response.condition: below 250 achieved TFLOP/s/GPU or unreliable DDP
throughput_response.action: fall back to bf16 Torch kernels as needed and reduce flagship training to 320B tokens

flagship_budget_reconciliation.decision: before P4, replace planning arithmetic with measured exact-shape end-to-end tokens per second and checkpoint/evaluation overhead; do not simultaneously treat 350 TFLOP/s as achieved end-to-end throughput and multiply it by a second generic overhead
flagship_budget_reconciliation.fallback: freeze 320B tokens when the 400B projection exceeds the authorized flagship plus explicitly released reserve envelope

supersedes.reason: freeze the 1.2B target, strengthen the central interaction to five seeds, replace generic scale reruns with a mature-horizon sentinel, and preserve the 5,000-hour ceiling
